name: ASAP Portable Toilet Calculator
author: ASAP

sections.description:
The Portable Toilet Calculator helps contractors, event planners, and project managers quickly estimate how many portable restrooms are needed based on workforce size and project duration.

This plugin provides a clean, user-friendly calculator that can be embedded anywhere on your site using a shortcode.

Features

  • Easy-to-use calculator interface
  • Shortcode support for flexible placement
  • Lightweight and fast — no unnecessary scripts
  • Works with all modern WordPress themes
  • No required external services

Usage

Add the calculator to any page or post using the shortcode:

[portable_toilet_calculator]

The calculator will render automatically and allow users to input their project details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Add the shortcode [portable_toilet_calculator] to any page or post
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an external account?

No. The calculator works fully within your WordPress site.

Can I customize the styling?

Yes. You can override styles using your theme’s CSS.

Does this plugin collect user data?

No. This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit user data.
